speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to help you, can you tell me how long the breathing difficulties have been present?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) in a premature infant.

Given the gestational age of 33 weeks and onset of distress within two hours of birth, I am highly suspicious of surfactant deficiency due to immaturity of the lungs. Can you tell me if the baby was delivered via Cesarean section or if there were any complications during labor?
